question: What claim about the speaker's intention is made by stating an intention to tell the arrangement of the yoginī row to the beloved?
premises: The speaker intends to tell the arrangement of the yoginī row.
This is addressed to the beloved.
The object of telling is specified.
inference: The speaker declares an intention to disclose the arrangement of the yoginī row to the beloved.
uncertainties: The verse does not state when or under what conditions this disclosure will occur.
plain_english: I shall tell you, O beloved, the arrangement of the yoginī row.
